academic_units_fields_valid.name: academic_units_fields_valid
academic_units_fields_valid.value: btrim("academic_units"."kind") <> '' AND btrim("academic_units"."name") <> '' AND btrim("academic_units"."code") <> '' AND "academic_units"."code" = upper(btrim("academic_units"."code"))

lecture_audio_derivatives_processing_sta.name: lecture_audio_derivatives_processing_state_valid
lecture_audio_derivatives_processing_sta.value: ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" = 'processing' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."processing_started_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" <> 'processing' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."processing_started_at" IS NULL)

lecture_audio_derivatives_ready_state_va.name: lecture_audio_derivatives_ready_state_valid
lecture_audio_derivatives_ready_state_va.value: ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" = 'ready' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_provider" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_provider") <> '' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND btrim("lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_key") <> '' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."byte_size" IS NOT NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."byte_size" > 0 AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("lecture_audio_derivatives"."status" <> 'ready' AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_provider" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."storage_key" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."byte_size" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."sha256" IS NULL AND "lecture_audio_derivatives"."completed_at" IS NULL)
